title: Naturality of the canonical rational pullback tensor comparison
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, and a scheme map f:X→Y with l invertible in all residue fields. For the prescribed rational pullback and tensor functors [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] and the localized canonical comparison of [def-pur-completed-pullback-tensor-construction], its components mu(M,N) are natural in both inputs: for arrows a:M→M′ and b:N→N′, pullback(tensor(a,b)) followed by mu(M′,N′) equals mu(M,N) followed by tensor(pullback(a),pullback(b)).

source.place: Tag 07A4, lemma-pullback-tensor-product; naturality of the canonical comparison, followed by scalar localization.

proof.text: Whisker the integral pullback and tensor realization isomorphisms with the constructible inclusions. The coherent reduction/limit counit is a natural transformation. On the normalized tensor inputs and pulled-back inputs the existing counit theorem makes its components invertible; ofComponents therefore gives natural counit isomorphisms. Compose these isomorphisms with the coherent pullback/tensor comparison and restrict to the full constructible subcategory. Expanding the component maps identifies the resulting natural isomorphism with canonicalIntegralPullbackTensor.

Apply bilinearComparison_existsUnique to this integral natural isomorphism and the prescribed rational pullback/tensor functors, using their existing integral object and pure-tensor map specifications. Its normalized components equal canonicalRationalPullbackTensor by the defining heterogeneous equality of homs and Iso.ext. The naturality equation of the localized natural isomorphism is the desired equation.

lean.statement:
theorem canonicalRationalPullbackTensor_naturality
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    {M M' N N' : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l E Y} (a : M ⟶ M') (b : N ⟶ N') :
    (rationalDerivedPullback l E f).map
        ((rationalDerivedTensor l E Y).map (Prod.mkHom a b)) ≫
      (canonicalRationalPullbackTensor l E f M' N').hom =
    (canonicalRationalPullbackTensor l E f M N).hom ≫
      (rationalDerivedTensor l E X).map
        (Prod.mkHom ((rationalDerivedPullback l E f).map a)
          ((rationalDerivedPullback l E f).map b))
